* Conduct advanced quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify healthcare improvement opportunities, evaluate innovative solutions, and validate findings using statistical methods, machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and predictive or prescriptive analytics. * Extract, integrate, and analyze structured and unstructured clinical data from electronic health records and other sources, including wearable devices, sensors, diagnostic imaging, vital signs, and patient-generated data. * Lead cross-functional teams in gathering requirements, assessing needs, establishing priorities, and developing roadmaps, testing plans, and deployment strategies for healthcare analytics solutions. * Develop and implement analytics architecture, technical standards, and development methods addressing prototyping, code review, metadata, testing, change control, security, documentation, and software release. * Maintain, manage, and configure complementary enterprise and developmental software systems that support data analytics, clinical and administrative workflows, collaboration, safety, quality, and organizational efficiency. * Coordinate project resources and provide scientific, technical, and operational direction to interdisciplinary teams, including VA staff, academic researchers, private-sector collaborators, and other government partners. * Develop and deliver training, instruction, and technical guidance on data interpretation and analytics systems; lead user adoption and change-management activities across the VHA data science community. * Develop proof-of-concept analytics solutions and coordinate their implementation into clinical practice, including integration of clinical decision-support tools into electronic health records, in collaboration with appropriate technical, privacy, security, legal, and information technology partners. * Evaluate project feasibility, implementation progress, and clinical or operational impact using key performance indicators, end-user feedback, and other performance measures; resolve technical and systems-performance problems and recommend improvements. * Present findings, decision briefings, technical recommendations, and scientific manuscripts to executive leaders, stakeholders, and professional audiences; advise on emerging technologies and the development and expansion of effective healthcare analytics solutions
**Work Schedule:** Monday - Friday, 8:00a.m. - 4:30p.m. PST

Incumbent may be required to work evenings and weekends, as well as perform infrequent overnight travel to meetings and conferences.

**To qualify for this position,** applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement.
**Individual Occupational Requirements:(IOR)****Basic Requirements:**
**Degree:** I successfully completed a degree in Mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or field directly related to the position. The degree must be in a major field of study (at least at the baccalaureate level) that is appropriate for the position. (TRANSCRIPT REQUIRED)

item.title: Data Scientist, Finance - Meta
item.description:
Meta is seeking a highly quantitative, analytical, and motivated data scientist for the Finance Data Science team. The Finance DS team has a unique bird's-eye view of Meta's large-scale advertising business and is positioned at the center of some of the most important strategic decisions for the company. This position will focus heavily on analyzing and modeling revenue drivers, understanding the ads ecosystem, building forecast models, and developing actionable insights to influence strong financial decision making. The role is highly cross-functional and partner facing, involving coordination across a variety of data science, product, and finance teams. Candidates should have a track record of delivering actionable and data-driven insights; you're able to effectively combine deep technical expertise and business acumen, and drive to results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. As an individual contributor, you will also be expected to raise the quality of the data science craft at Meta, and to provide technical leadership and mentorship to other data scientists.

* Own and lead data science projects end-to-end in partnership with other data science, finance, or cross-functional teams to inform and influence product investment decisions * Build frameworks and statistical models to analyze business implications, influence measurement standards, and extrapolate experiment results and historical trends into accurate and explainable forecasts * Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches * Navigate complex cross-functional situations and evaluate statistical analyses by other data science teams to reach alignment on objective business outcomes * Influence financial and product direction through clear and compelling presentations, including to leadership * Raise the bar of data science at Meta, including but not limited to driving data best practices (e.g., analysis, goaling, forecasting), improving analytical processes, scaling knowledge and tools, and mentoring other data scientists

**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Brand advertising is at the center of that growth, and brand marketers are pushing the industry toward a fundamental shift: they no longer want to optimize toward proxy metrics like reach and frequency alone. They want their investment across Streaming TV, online video, and display to drive measurable business outcomes, from consideration through to purchase and long-term loyalty. The core scientific challenge is connecting a brand ad exposure today to an outcome that may happen days or weeks later, and then optimizing for it in real time.
The Brand Outcomes Optimization team exists to solve that challenge. We build machine-learned models that predict how likely a customer is to move along the full funnel, from awareness through conversion, and we integrate those predictions into real-time bidding so that every brand bid is placed on the opportunity most likely to produce the outcome the advertiser cares about. These systems operate at large scale, and even small improvements to how we predict and optimize for outcomes have meaningful and immediate impact on advertiser results.
As an Applied Scientist II, you will help drive this outcome-optimization. You will take on increasingly ambiguous problems, from predicting what a brand outcome will be, to building the bidding and control algorithms that optimize for it, to proving the lift through experimentation. You will work alongside senior scientists and engineers, applying advances in machine learning, online optimization, optimal control, forecasting, and causal inference. You will also join the Amazon science community, with opportunities to publish papers, attend workshops and conferences, and gain early access to Amazon ML technologies.

The Applied Scientist will build the learning environments that let AIVista train and evaluate agents before they act in real regulated workflows. This role blends reinforcement learning research with environment engineering. You will design reward and cost functions, generate curricula and counterfactual cases, validate simulator fidelity against real operations, and develop offline, safe, constrained, and multi-agent learning methods. The Applied Scientist will develop methods that turn natural-language intent into structured, machine-checkable artifacts and use those artifacts to make AI-driven software development more verifiable, traceable, and reliable. You will work from policies, regulations, standard operating procedures, requirements, process descriptions, application programming interfaces, and code to construct formal specifications, rule ontologies, process ontologies, contracts, tests, and proofs with complete source traceability.
The work addresses two distinct assurance problems. Validation asks whether a formal artifact faithfully captures authorized intent. Verification asks whether an implementation satisfies that artifact. You will build measurable validation methods for omissions and mistranslations, integrate independent checkers and proof systems, and carry the resulting evidence through the AI-driven software development life cycle. The objective is a practical development workflow in which models may propose requirements, designs, code, tests, or proofs, while deterministic checkers, versioned evidence, and human authority determine what is accepted.

**Description** AWS Elemental builds media services used by broadcasters, streaming platforms, and sports leagues to prepare, process, deliver, and monetize video. Elemental Inference is the applied machine learning team within that organization. We develop models that understand and transform live and file-based video, producing capabilities such as intelligent reframing, highlight detection, video enhancement, and contextual metadata for advertising and content discovery. Our work reaches customers through the same media workflows that carry major live events, always-on channels, and large on-demand libraries.
As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will develop new machine learning approaches and carry the strongest ideas into production. Current work spans multimodal video, audio, and language models; spatial and temporal understanding; active-speaker and point-of-interest detection; scene retrieval; video super-resolution; and learned methods for improving compression. These problems rarely have a single accepted metric or a ready-made dataset. You will help define the task itself, determine what evidence is needed, and build evaluation methods that reflect the experience of people watching and working with the resulting video.
This role combines applied research with the practical demands of a real-time media service. You will design datasets and objectives, train models at scale, run controlled comparisons, and investigate failures. You will also work closely with engineers to export, optimize, and deploy those models. A result is not finished when it performs well in a notebook. It must preserve its quality after conversion, fit within GPU memory, meet latency and throughput targets, handle the temporal behavior of live video, and operate at a cost customers can sustain.
You will be a technical leader on the team as well as an individual contributor. The role calls for someone who can take an ambiguous customer problem, separate the scientific questions from the engineering constraints, and lead a team toward a defensible answer. You will review experiments and models, mentor other scientists and engineers, and improve the shared methods the team uses for training and evaluation. Strong judgment matters here. So does the ability to explain a complicated result clearly, including its limitations, to people from several disciplines.
We welcome candidates with deep experience in computer vision, multimodal learning, video processing, or related areas. Direct media experience is valuable but not required. A scientist who has solved difficult problems in another field, understands how to test ideas rigorously, and wants to learn the video domain can also succeed in this role.
Key job responsibilities
Lead the formulation of ambiguous video problems into research plans with clear datasets, objectives, baselines, evaluation protocols, and production acceptance criteria.
Develop models for multimodal video understanding and generation, spatial and temporal reasoning, detection and tracking, scene retrieval, video enhancement, and learned compression.
Develop models for multimodal video understanding and description, spatial and temporal reasoning, detection and tracking, scene retrieval, video enhancement, and learned compression.
Build evaluations that measure the behavior customers will see. Depending on the problem, this may include task accuracy, factual support, temporal localization, retrieval quality, perceptual video quality, rate-distortion performance, or human review.
Take models from research code to production-ready artifacts. Partner with engineers on model export, reduced-precision inference, quantization, numerical parity, accelerator-specific optimization, and integration with serving systems and video pipelines.
Balance model quality against latency, throughput, GPU memory, context limits, and operating cost. Diagnose problems across training stability, data quality, precision, compilation, serving, and live temporal behavior.
Build reusable mechanisms for dataset management, experimentation, model comparison, regression detection, and performance measurement rather than solving each research problem in isolation.
Review scientific work and production code. Identify weak comparisons, data leakage, unsupported conclusions, untested edge cases, and operational risks before they reach customers.
Work with product managers, software engineers, and other scientists to make scope and design decisions. Use evidence to resolve disagreement and communicate what is known, what remains uncertain, and what further work is worth doing.
Mentor scientists and engineers in experimental design, machine learning methods, video evaluation, and production ML practices.
Contribute applied research through internal technical reports, patents, and publications at appropriate conferences or workshops.
**About The Team** AWS Elemental provides a portfolio of cloud media services built to prepare, process, deliver, and monetize video at global scale. Our technology supports some of the world's largest live broadcasts as well as 24/7 channels and on-demand content. The broader organization brings together expertise in video coding, image processing, distributed systems, advertising, and the operational demands of professional media.
Elemental Inference applies machine learning across that video pipeline. The team works on video understanding and enhancement, contextual metadata, smart composition, event detection, retrieval, and compression. Some projects use large multimodal models that combine video, audio, and language. Others use specialized temporal or spatial models designed for a narrow task and a strict real-time budget. We choose the approach that fits the customer problem rather than forcing every problem into the same model family.
Scientists on the team own more than model architecture. item.description:
**Description** Amazon Ads is one of the fastest-growing advertising businesses in the world, connecting brands with hundreds of millions of customers across shopping, streaming, gaming, audio and the open web. Behind every ad that runs on Prime Video, Twitch, IMDb and thousands of external publisher apps and sites is a decisioning platform built by Amazon Ads Supply Tech.
That platform makes X trillion ad decisions every day and supports $XB+ in annual publisher revenue across XX+ Amazon-owned publishers and X,000+ external publishers in streaming TV, audio, display, mobile and podcasts. Every one of those decisions is a science problem: which inventory qualifies for which buyers, how publisher commitments are paced and delivered, which ad wins among competing candidates, and what price maximizes long-term yield. Each must be solved in milliseconds, under strict latency and cost budgets, while balancing advertisers, publishers, viewers and Amazon. At this scale, a fraction-of-a-percent model improvement is worth $X millions.
We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist for this platform. You will decide where machine learning creates the most value, bring intelligence into real-time runtime systems, and lead models from idea to production.
As a principal, you will be a technical leader across the organization. You will raise the science bar, mentor senior scientists, and influence product and engineering leaders. You will work alongside excellent, driven scientists, engineers and product leaders who take on hard problems and invest in each other’s growth. Few places in the world operate at this scale.
Key job responsibilities
* Define the ML strategy for the ad decisioning platform. Set a multi-year science vision across pricing, yield optimization, forecasting, ad selection and commitment delivery, tied to measurable business outcomes. * Identify opportunities to deploy intelligence in runtime systems. Find where rules and heuristics in real-time serving paths can be replaced or improved by learned models, and partner with engineering to fit them within latency, compute and reliability budgets. * Build ML models that operate at X trillion decisions a day, drawing on approaches such as deep learning, reinforcement learning and bandits, causal inference, forecasting, and auction and mechanism design. * Evaluate ML models rigorously. Design offline, counterfactual and off-policy evaluations and online experiments. Define metrics that capture long-term value for advertisers, publishers and viewers, not just short-term lift. * Refine models for output quality and performance. Improve accuracy, calibration and robustness, cut serving latency and cost, and monitor models in production for drift and degradation. * Set technical standards, review science designs and launches, and mentor and grow senior and principal-track scientists. * Push the frontier, including LLM and agentic approaches, and contribute to Amazon’s internal and external science community through papers, talks and patents.

Start the day reviewing off-policy evaluation results for a new pricing model that projects an X% yield lift, and deciding with your team whether it is ready for an online test. Next, you work with engineers on fitting a deeper model into a millisecond latency budget at X billion requests. At midday, you dig into why a forecasting model drifted during a live sports event, and sketch a fix. Later, you review a scientist’s paper draft and present the science roadmap to product leaders. We serve Amazon-owned publishers such as Prime Video, Twitch and IMDb, along with thousands of external publishers across streaming TV, audio and display. Our models decide, in milliseconds, which inventory qualifies for which buyers, how commitments are delivered, which ad wins and at what price, balancing advertisers, publishers, viewers and Amazon. At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.
In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic
In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.
This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.
**The Role** Bedrock Robotics is hiring a Data Scientist to lead high-impact data science work across autonomy, safety, and product. In this role, you will operate as a senior technical individual contributor, partnering closely with autonomy, machine learning, backend, and product teams to extract insights from complex, real-world data generated by autonomous construction machines and their operators.
You will work across the full data science lifecycle (problem framing, analysis, measurement, and communication) while helping establish foundational practices for how data science is applied at Bedrock. This role is ideal for a senior-to-staff-level data scientist who enjoys operating in ambiguous problem spaces, working close to production systems, and delivering insights that directly influence engineering and product decisions.
**What You'll Do**
* Own and execute data science work across autonomy, safety, and product, focusing on the highest-impact analytical problems * Analyze machine telemetry, operational data, and user workflows to surface insights that improve system performance, safety, and usability * Define and track key metrics that measure system behavior and product outcomes * Design and evaluate experiments, analyses, and validation approaches in partnership with engineering and product teams * Collaborate closely with ML platform and data engineering teams to ensure data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analysis * Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influencing roadmap and design decisions * Contribute to the foundation of data science practices at Bedrock, helping shape how future work and teams scale
**Required Qualifications**
* 5+ years of experience in data science, applied analytics, or applied machine learning roles * Comfort operating as a senior IC in a fast-growing startup, balancing execution with technical judgment and prioritization * Ability to work independently, define analytical approaches, and drive projects from concept to insight * Experience working with complex, high-volume, or real-time data (e.g., robotics, autonomy, geospatial systems, computer vision outputs, IoT, ad-tech, or large-scale consumer platforms) * Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and data analysis, with a track record of influencing decisions through data * Hands-on experience collaborating with data engineering and infrastructure teams on data pipelines, data quality, and scalable analysis workflows * Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using modern tooling like agentic AI * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field (advanced degree welcome but not required)
**Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer** We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.
**Reasonable Accommodations** We want our hiring process to be accessible to everyone. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you.

item.title: Sr. Lead Data Scientist - Early Warning
item.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.
Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.
Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.
The Sr. Lead Data Scientist is a senior individual contributor and technical leader within the data science organization, responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced machine learning and statistical solutions in a complex, high-volume, high-throughput data environment. This role plays a critical leadership function by owning end-to-end modeling initiatives, guiding analytical direction for major business problems, and mentoring data scientists across multiple projects.
This position is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence modeling standards and best practices, and partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable, production-ready analytics solutions.
**Essential Functions** **Advanced Modeling & Technical Leadership**
* Leads the design, experimentation, and implementation of advanced machine learning, statistical, and optimization models to solve complex, high-impact business problems. * Serves as the technical owner for large-scale, business-critical models, including model selection, feature engineering, training strategy, validation, and performance monitoring. * Drives development of complex consumer or entity profiles used for both offline model training and real-time scoring. * Assesses and ensures long-term performance, stability, scalability, and interpretability of analytically derived models in production environments. * Establishes modeling standards, evaluation frameworks, and best practices adopted across the data science team.
**Project & Cross-Functional Leadership**
* Takes a lead role in the development and delivery of product-prototype and production models, coordinating across multiple data science and engineering contributors. * Partners with software engineers and MLOps teams to define statistical components, data requirements, unit testing, acceptance testing, and deployment strategies. * Translates ambiguous, high-level business goals into clearly defined analytical problems, roadmaps, and measurable success criteria. * Identifies and recommends new modeling, analytics, and data opportunities aligned with business strategy.
**Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing**
* Acts as a senior mentor and subject matter expert, coaching junior and mid-level data scientists on modeling techniques, analytical thinking, and technical execution. * Reviews analytical work, model designs, and code for quality, rigor, and alignment with best practices. * Shares knowledge of emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies through documentation, presentations, and informal leadership.
**Communication & Documentation**
* Clearly documents model design, assumptions, workflows, and performance results for both technical and non-technical audiences. * Presents analytical findings, model outcomes, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership with clarity and confidence.
**Data Stewardship & Compliance**
* Supports the company’s commitment to protecting the integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate use of systems and data. * Ensures models and analytical solutions adhere to governance, regulatory, and ethical standards.
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field. * Typically 10+ years of professional experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical analysis, or equivalent advanced education and experience. * Extensive hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets in high-volume environments. * Advanced proficiency in data science and machine learning tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Java, or equivalent. * Deep experience with a broad range of machine learning methods, including classification, regression, tree-based models, SVMs, ensemble methods, and optimization techniques. * Proven ability to translate business requirements into robust analytical designs and production-ready models. * Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating data scientists on complex projects. * Successful completion of background and drug screening.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* PhD or Master’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field. * Deep expertise in advanced machine learning algorithms and modern ML frameworks and libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Strong experience writing, optimizing, and tuning complex SQL queries. * Experience designing and maintaining data science pipelines and workflows in Python, R, or similar languages. * Experience working with financial or regulated data environments. * Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while balancing multiple priorities. * Track record of discovering non-obvious insights and patterns in complex datasets.
Physical Requirements
Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers.
**The Base Pay Scale For This Position In** Phoenix, AZ/ Chicago, IL in USD per year is: $150,000 - $200,000.
New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA in USD per year is: $210,000 - $270,000.
Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits.

Early Warning Services takes into consideration a variety of factors when determining a competitive salary offer, including, but not limited to, the job scope, market rates and geographic location of a position, candidate’s education, experience, training, and specialized skills or certification(s) in relation to the job requirements and compared with internal equity (peers). The business actively supports and reviews wage equity to ensure that pay decisions are not based on gender, race, national origin, or any other protected classes.

item.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/30/2026
This is a hybrid role based thrice a week in Cisco's San Jose, CA office.
**Meet The Team** We are seeking a highly skilled AI Data Scientist / Data Analyst to join our Silicon One Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will leverage sophisticated analytics, machine learning, and AI agent technologies to drive yield analysis, debug, and predictive modeling for our semiconductor manufacturing processes. Your work will directly impact product quality, test cost, manufacturing efficiency, and time-to-market for Cisco’s industry-leading silicon solutions.
**Your Impact**
* Develop, deploy, and maintain AI/ML models for yield analysis, yield debug, and early-stage failure prediction in semiconductor manufacturing. * Build and optimize AI agents to automate data-driven root cause analysis and yield improvement initiatives. * Analyze large-scale manufacturing, test, and parametric datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights. * Collaborate with hardware, test, and process engineering teams to translate business and technical requirements into robust data science solutions. * Design and implement predictive models to forecast yield and quality metrics at various stages of the manufacturing flow. * Communicate findings and recommendations to multi-functional teams through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations. * Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, data analytics, and semiconductor manufacturing best practices. * Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
**Minimum Qualifications**
* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. * 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or data analytics, preferably in semiconductor or hardware engineering environments. * Strong proficiency in Python and data science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Experience building, validating, and deploying AI/ML models for classification, regression, anomaly detection, and time-series forecasting. * Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks and automation of data analysis workflows. * Solid understanding of semiconductor manufacturing, test data, and yield analysis concepts. * Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., matplotlib, seaborn, Tableau, Power BI).
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and big data technologies. * Familiarity with Optuna or other hyperparameter optimization frameworks. * Knowledge of hardware debug, root cause analysis, and reliability engineering.
Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
